$help: Every word of the emails the site's forms cause. mail/render.js fills the tokens in braces: {product} {email} {name} {company} {role} {time} {date} {due} {kitName} {count} {missing} {links} {error}.

The sender reads this file from GitHub on every request, so a saved change applies within a minute. Preview any change first: node tools/mail-preview.js --sample, then read .work/mail-preview/as-read.txt, the emails as their readers receive them.
Rules the checker holds: no em dashes; an artifact name at most 24 characters and its use line at most 95; the walkthrough is called "Interactive demo".

productPage.name: Product page
productPage.use: Send the link before the first meeting, so the customer arrives already briefed.

onePager.name: One-pager
onePager.use: Leave it behind after the meeting: one sheet the sponsor can forward up the chain.

salesDeck.name: Sales deck
salesDeck.use: On the call, open it and walk the buyer from their problem to a proof of value on their data.

featureList.name: Feature list
featureList.use: When IT or procurement wants the scope confirmed line by line, hand this over.

interactiveDemo.name: Interactive demo
interactiveDemo.use: Click through it on a shared screen the moment someone says ‘show me’.

video.name: Demo video
video.use: For anyone who missed the call, add it to the follow-up note and they can watch it there.
